environment.description: Kubernetes 1.24 cluster with no PodSecurityPolicy or Pod Security Standards enforcement. The WebSocket service runs as a privileged container with hostPath volume mounts at /var/run/ws-service mapped to the node's /var/run directory. A sidecar container (monitoring agent) shares the PID namespace and can send arbitrary signals to the ws-service process. The container runs as root (UID 0) with SYS_PTRACE capability. An attacker with access to the monitoring sidecar can rapidly send SIGUSR1/SIGHUP signals to trigger the race condition, corrupt shared state written to the hostPath volume, and potentially pivot to other pods reading the same node-level /var/run path.
